headline: Macklemore Announces ‘Free Palestine’ Concerts After Exiting Ed Sheeran Tour
context: The rapper, who was pulled from Ed Sheeran’s tour last week over his support for Palestinians, announced plans for three European dates.

sources.name: The New York Times
